south-na-2022.notes: The site report says 42 teams but its two scoreboards list 36 (Division I) and 5 (Division II); site holds South Central USA teams only, while source 2 merges three regions.

sources.evidence: The front page is headed 'SCUSA 2022 ICPC South Central USA Regional Contest - Southern Conference' and its contest report is dated Saturday, 2/25/2023.
Kattis standings page titled 'ICPC NA South Division 2022 - Division 1' with 152 team rows and per-problem columns A to M.
Page headed 'The 2022 ICPC Mid-Atlantic USA Regional Contest' with 125 team rows whose site citations are Division 1 and Division 2 sites of the Mid-Atlantic part of the combined contest.
Kattis problems page of 'ICPC NA South Division 2022 - Division 1' listing 13 problems A Fading Wind to M Alchemy.
Kattis problems page of 'ICPC NA South Division 2022 - Division 2' listing 13 problems A Blueberry Waffle to M Alchemy.
PDF whose page footers read '2022 ICPC South Central USA Regional Division 2 Problem A: Blueberry Waffle' and so on, with problems A to M.
Slides titled '2022 South Conference Division 1 Solutions' by The Judges, dated Feb 25, 2023, 30 pages covering problems A to M.
Slides titled '2022 South Conference Division 2 Solutions' by The Judges, dated Feb 25, 2023, 26 pages covering problems A to M.

south-na-2023.notes: Source 1 is the Mid-Atlantic regional site only (one of three regions of the combined contest) and holds pages of several editions captured at different dates, plus unrelated Radford pages and a C++ documentation mirror. Kattis shows times in CET (20:00-01:06), which are not local contest times.

Page headed 'The 2023 ICPC Mid-Atlantic USA Regional Contest' with 123 team rows whose citations are Division 1 and Division 2 places, the Mid-Atlantic part of the combined contest.
